messages:
Elena V.: Hi team, first day and need a hand. Laptop arrived but tracking says monitor + TB dock delivered to 'Front Desk' and I don't see them at my desk (5F-03). Also can't join 'Redwood-Staff' Wi-Fi: '802.1X authentication failed'. I created ticket #6921 but pinging here for visibility.

IT Helpdesk Bot: Ticket #6921 received and assigned to Marco (IT). ETA ~25m. If urgent, mention @Marco (IT). :wave:

Marco (IT): Welcome Elena! Can you paste the carrier tracking number? For Wi-Fi, try connecting to 'Redwood-Guest' and grab the one-time token from your onboarding email. Which OS are you on?

Elena V.: Tracking: CN321098765US showing 'Delivered to Front Desk' at 08:50. I'm on macOS 13.4. I don't see any guest token in the onboarding email.

Harpreet - Mailroom: Hi @Elena V., CN321098765US is on Shelf C tagged 'New Hires'. I can bring it up to 5F in 15 minutes or leave it at Front Desk for pickup.

Marco (IT): DMing a guest token now. If the 802.1X popup rejects your password, when the dialog appears choose 'Use System' and enter your SSO email (not local machine account) plus the token. If that still fails, I'll request a cert refresh.

Carlos - Facilities: Dropped off monitor+dock at 5F-03 just now. Left a note. :package:

Elena V.: Got the package, thanks Carlos! Tried the DM token but still saw 802.1X error.

Marco (IT): Pushing cert refresh for your user (NW-325). In meantime, try removing old Wi-Fi profiles: System Settings -> Profiles and delete any 'Redwood' profiles, then reboot Wi-Fi.

Elena V.: Removed an old profile and rebooted Wi-Fi, then it asked for credentials — entered SSO + token and connected. :tada: Monitor and dock working but external monitor is at 1024x768.

Marco (IT): For Mac, open System Settings -> Displays -> Resolution and pick 'Default for display' or the scaled option matching your monitor native res. If scaling looks off, hold Option and click 'Detect Displays'. If issues persist send a quick screenshot and I can remote in.

Elena V.: Switched to Default and looks great now. Big thanks everyone for the help — excited to be here! :heart:
